prerequisites: Exam question outlines: State space and methods for its complete search. A* algorithm and its properties.
Exam question outlines: Use of the state space and its algorithms in problem solving and action planning.
Exam question outlines: Machine learning. Types of machine learning tasks.
Exam question outlines: Basic clustering algorithms and their practical applications.
Exam question outlines: Basic algorithm for decision tree construction and its application.
Exam question outlines: Propositional logic, its syntax, semantics and the notion of logical consequence.
Exam question outlines: Proof means of propositional logic - resolution and its properties.
Exam question outlines: Application of propositional logic in practical knowledge work tasks.
Exam question outlines: Neural networks, basic principles of perceptron, loss function, back propagation, MLP.
Exam question outlines: Convolutional neural networks - principle of convolution, architecture and typical operations, applications.
Exam question outlines: Genetic algorithms - basic concepts (population, objective function, GA cycle). Comparison of evolutionary and swarm algorithms.
syllabus_topics: What is the purpose of AI, what AI can do now and what impact it has on society.
State space and methods for solving typical problems.
State space - search complexity and how to face it.
Machine learning and its basic algorithms. Clustering.
Learning from classified data. Combination of classifiers.
Problem solving theory and the use of formal logic.
Deep learning, convolutional neural networks, influence of architecture
Neural networks for natural language processing, RNN, LSTM; Transformers.
assessment_rules: Credit conditions require active participation (at least 70% attendance in labs) and submission of 3 out of 5 assigned individual tasks. Each task must be submitted within 14 days from its assignment. Points for submitted tasks decrease by 1 point per day of delay beyond the deadline until reaching 0 points. These earned points contribute to the overall evaluation for the final exam.
